page.layout: One printed title page, one column of centred lines; below it a Scripture citation, a printing note and an imprint; handwriting at the lower right (not transcribed).

main_text.l: modo eadem in unam Christi perso-
nam conueniant, ac inconfusæ permaneant, si-
ue præpositiones: idem by postea Christi mani-
festam propriam predicationem minime ab esse ubiq.
Respondeatur iuxta beatam ad argumenta doc-
stratur & Caro Christi dominica negotium, perspi-
stratur, Corpus Christi non esse ubiq.
Ego enim stigmata Domini nostri Iesu Christi in corpore meo porto.

page.notes: Title page of a 16th-century printed book, Zurich, Froschauer, 1561. The Galatians quotation and the place and date lines are set in a smaller or different type; the Greek and line-end readings in the Galatians lines are partly illegible on the scan, and the lines are transcribed as far as legible. Handwritten ownership note in the lower right is excluded. Dark stamp-like marks at right are excluded. The first Galatians line and the printer's line are uncertain: "Excudebat" and "Mense Martio" are conjectural readings of blurred letters.
